reviews.text: I can’t stop watching my little one after such amazing job. Very detailed oriented and I never saw her fur so shiny and fluffy like that. Cheers!
Vickie did an amazing grooming on my little Yorkie. It was his first professional grooming and he looked awesome. I highly recommend her and I will be back for his next grooming!

Mitchel is a schnauzer with a lot of personality, not to mention a bit grumpy, and yet Viktoria was so patient and careful with him that I felt at ease from beginning to end.

The work was spectacular: attentive to every detail, without rushing, and it's immediately clear that she understands the breed. We left with an unrecognizable dog and a relaxed owner. I recommend her without reservation.
At home, we laugh about bringing a homeless person to Victoria and taking away candy. It's the same every time.
My dog looked calm and happy when I picked her up and I liked the cut. Recommend!

Without any doubt the best service in Lisboa! Best service for our black Scottish UBBY !!!
Many thanks
I've been getting my dog ​​washed here exclusively for a year now, and I'm very happy. I've already booked my next visit.
Vickie and her team are wonderful—you can tell they genuinely love dogs and are patient, empathetic groomers. We also really appreciate that they offer shampoos suitable for allergy-prone pups too.
Such a wonderful grooming salon! They groomed my dog exactly how I wanted - very carefully, gently, and beautifully. I’m really happy with the result and the service. We’ll definitely be back!

I took my wire-haired teckel to Paws’N’Surf for a classic stripping cut, and unfortunately the experience fell far short of expectations. The groomer didn’t ask how we wanted the cut, so I proactively showed her a photo of the exact style we were looking for. Even then, things didn’t go well.

The session was supposed to take 3 hours but ended up lasting 4, and despite the extra time, the grooming looked unfinished. When we arrived to pick him up, the top of his head hadn’t even been touched. The groomer’s expression made it clear she knew the result wasn’t right. We were still charged 70€, and once we got home, we had to complete the grooming ourselves.

If you have a wire-haired teckel and want a proper classic stripping cut, I cannot recommend this place.
High level of professionalism and attention, also a very pleasant space♥️
Huge thanks for the review, it means a lot to us!
The best place for grooming♡
The level of love for dogs and the level of service are excellent! Highly professional. I really like the atmosphere inside. You can always ask for advice on care.
One of the best pet groomer in Lisbon. Thank you for making my little boy look amazing.
One of the best and most professional groomers I’ve ever used for my two Mini Schnauzers. I highly recommend them — and so do my dogs!
Such a lovely place. Cozy venue, knowledgeable stuff, clear communication, comfortable booking. My Maltipoo is happy and looks cute.

This is our third visit with Vickie for hand stripping our border terrier and we have been very happy with her services. Every time Emmi comes back to us looking so fresh and cute.

Our Emmi does not love the process of getting hand stripped and she is an anxious doggy but Vickie is always so sweet and gentle with her. Vickie does an amazing job and highly recommend!
Great grooming ❤️
We truly appreciate your support and high rating ☺️

This is the second time I’ve taken my Australian terrier here. I’m so thankful that I did my research and found an excellent groomer for my boy so quickly. I adore Vickie, she is so great and attentive to her furry clients, and is a perfectionist. I highly recommend PawsN’Surf!
Thank you so much for your support!
Care and attentive attitude, the dog is under the supervision of a professional. Haircut and grooming are done taking into account all wishes. Comfortable place❤️
Best groomer ever ❤️ we'd worked together for many years and I was always very impressed by her work 😘 …

My older dog was very much in need of a quality groom service as you can see on the 2 Before photos.
Yesterday we had a visit and my dog is like new, looking like a toy and collecting compliments in the street. She got now trimmed hair and nails, a more straight leg hairs (“pants”) cut as per my request. Its also important that the hair was treated gently during the procedure and the hairs did not get broken. Besides, I received recommendations for the younger dog and links to the products I could use.
I also noticed that my younger’s dog active behaviour was not only tolerated, but managed in the correct way: a bit of play time for her to let the energy out. And its especially nice that the older dog was given some time to accomodate to the new place and calm down before starting the grooming.
Well, these are the details that are important to me.
Thank you so much, definitely coming back 🫶
Wonderful salon! And Vika is a very caring and attentive groomer❤️
